name: Villaobispo de Otero (Spain)
description: Square flag divided diagonally from the upper fly to the lower hoist, white in the centre with red and green triangles, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Villaobispo de Otero (a mitre and a wheel on green).
history: Municipal flag of Villaobispo de Otero; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Villaobispo de Otero arms — mitre and wheel on green
